# Best MagSafe car mounts (Qi2)

**Best overall for most iPhone drivers: Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W Vent Mount, $47.99**
Three of the guides pick it as best overall. It includes a 1 m USB-C cable and a 27W car adapter, rotates between portrait and landscape, and fits cases up to 3 mm thick. If your vents are awkward, Belkin also makes a vent/dash version at the same price. ([RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/))

**Fastest: Anker Prime Wireless Car Charger (MagGo, AirCool, A2933), $89.99**
It charges at Qi2 25W, which needs an iPhone 16 or 17 series on iOS 26 and a 30W+ USB-C car charger. The Gadgeteer rates it best for reliability, with active cooling and a 60W adapter included. The Mountguys reviewer uses an Anker Prime Qi2 as their daily driver. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/), [Mountguys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/))

**Best value with cooling: ESR HaloLock 15W with CryoBoost**
This is Qi2-certified 15W with a built-in fan, so your phone is less likely to throttle while running maps in the heat. It mounts on an air vent or the dash. The Gadgeteer lists it at $35.99. Dealectric lists it at $39.99, or **$32.80 with code PARTNER18**, which they tested in ESR's cart on Oct 22 (the code expires Dec 31, 2026, and checkout has the final word).
👉 [Buy at ESR's US store via Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost). This is an affiliate link, so Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you.
Caveat: the page doesn't say whether a car adapter is included, so you may need your own.

**Other options**
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan**, from $39.95, is the Gadgeteer's best overall for iPhone 16/17.
- **iOttie Velox Mini Qi2**, $41.20, includes a charger and works on the dash or windshield.
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2**, $59.99, is the best-designed of the group.
- **Budget Amazon options** on the RottenWiFi page run about $14–27 (LISEN, ESR, Estbuc).

## How to choose
- Look for a **Qi2 badge**. A mount that only says "MagSafe-compatible" may charge at just 7.5W.
- **25W needs both** a newer iPhone (16/17) and a 30W+ car charger. Otherwise the 15W Belkin or ESR is plenty.
- If your phone overheats in summer, pick a fan-cooled model like the ESR CryoBoost or the Anker.
- Ignore marketing claims like "80LB suction" or "2400gf magnet." Mountguys says placement and mount stability matter more.

The search results didn't include direct purchase links for the Belkin, Anker, LISEN, iOttie or PITAKA mounts. The review pages above have retailer buy links, and prices may have changed since the guides were published.

If you tell me your iPhone model and whether you'd rather use a vent or the dash, I can narrow this to one pick.
